module_summary: Synchronous circular-buffer FIFO with read/write pointers and an occupancy counter, optional fall-through bypass, clock-gated memory update, and flush/clear of pointers.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: FIFO entry array written at write pointer, read at read pointer.

anchors.name: read_pointer_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting head entry for data_o.

anchors.name: write_pointer_q
anchors.why: Write pointer selecting entry to store pushed data.

anchors.name: status_cnt_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count producing full, empty and usage.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Pushed data written into mem or bypassed in fall-through.

anchors.name: push_i
anchors.why: Push request writing data when not full.

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Head data output from mem_q or fall-through input.

anchors.name: pop_i
anchors.why: Pop request advancing read pointer when not empty.

anchors.name: full_o
anchors.why: Full flag blocking pushes, from occupancy count.

anchors.name: empty_o
anchors.why: Empty flag blocking pops, fall-through aware.

anchors.name: usage_o
anchors.why: Fill level output from status counter.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush request clearing pointers and count.

anchors.name: gate_clock
anchors.why: Memory update enable, ungated only on accepted push.

groups.name: FIFO storage
groups.description: Entry array with gated write of pushed data.

groups.name: Pointer and count control
groups.description: Wrapping pointers and occupancy counter with flush/clear.

groups.name: Status flags
groups.description: Full, empty and usage derived from occupancy count.
